## Detection boundary

The model gateway check is a time-bound black-box protocol and behavior screen. It is not model-vendor certification, does not prove model identity from one run, and does not replace concurrency, latency, billing, privacy and long-term stability tests.

## Four quality gates

1. Access: DNS/TLS, authentication, model list and exact model ID.
2. Protocol: response structure, request ID, model claim and token arithmetic.
3. Behavior: random nonce, dynamic reasoning probe, SSE, tool calls and real workload tests.
4. Production: sample count, success rate, p50/p95, status distribution and cost.
